claims.text: Carmel Valley Ranch is a resort set on 500 acres in California.

findings.quote: LUXURY CALIFORNIA RESORT ON 500 ACRES

claims.text: The resort sits in the foothills of Monterey's Santa Lucia Mountains, about eight miles inland from the Pacific Ocean.

findings.quote: The foothills of Monterey’s Santa Lucia Mountains, about eight miles inland from the Pacific Ocean

claims.text: Suites have fireplaces, private decks and spa-inspired bathrooms with aromatherapy amenities.

findings.quote: Enjoy romantic fireplaces, private decks, spa-inspired bathrooms with aromatherapy amenities, and plenty of space

claims.text: Golf holes range from riverside par-3s to par-5s winding into the foothills of the Santa Lucias.

findings.quote: With holes ranging from riverside par-3s to challenging par-5s winding into the foothills of the Santa Lucias

claims.text: The resort has a four-acre working vineyard.

findings.quote: the resort boasts a four-acre working vineyard

claims.text: Spa Aiyana's facilities include a saltwater pool, an infinity hot tub, locker rooms with eucalyptus steam and a co-ed warming room.

findings.quote: including our saltwater pool, infinity hot tub, men’s and women’s locker rooms with eucalyptus steam, and co-ed warming room

claims.text: River Ranch, the main activity hub, has the Family Pool, a children's wading pool and splash pad, tennis and pickleball courts, and an adult pool.

findings.quote: Our main activity hub, River Ranch was made for all-ages fun
It’s home to the Family Pool, as well as our new children’s wading pool and splash pad, tennis and pickleball courts, an adult pool

claims.text: The Adventure Den offers activities for children aged 2 to 12, with a new theme each day of the week.

findings.quote: Offering age-appropriate activities for Adventure Tots (2-5) and Adventure Kids (5-12)
Each day of the week brings a new theme

claims.text: Daily activities range from guided hikes and yoga to archery lessons and picnics with a pair of resident miniature donkeys.

findings.quote: Daily activities range from guided hikes and yoga to archery lessons and picnics with Pablo and Paco, a pair of resident miniature donkeys.

claims.text: Dogs are welcome, with a special program that includes a bed, treats and pooch room service.

findings.quote: Of course you can bring your four-legged friend to The Ranch
our special program just for dogs includes a comfy bed, treats, and more. We’ve even got pooch room service!

claims.text: Swaths of lavender bloom on the grounds every summer and are used in the custom-made toiletries.

findings.quote: Swaths of lavender erupt on resort grounds every summer, and it’s showcased in custom-made toiletries.

claims.text: Signature restaurant Valley Kitchen showcases fresh, local ingredients, many of them grown or produced at the resort.

findings.quote: Menus at signature restaurant Valley Kitchen showcase fresh, local ingredients—many of which are grown or produced at the resort.

claims.text: Resident artisans craft cheese with milk from the ranch's own goats, grow grapes for its own wines and press oil from its own olives.

findings.quote: Here, artisans craft cheese with milk from our own goats, grow grapes for our own wines, press oil from our own olives.

claims.text: The golf course is a Pete Dye-designed bentgrass layout.

findings.quote: The only Pete Dye-designed bentgrass golf course in Northern California is right here at Carmel Valley Ranch

claims.text: Every room at the resort is a suite.

findings.quote: Every room at The Ranch is a suite

claims.text: Spa Aiyana has 12 treatment rooms and suites, most with private outdoor terraces.

findings.quote: Our feel-good getaway offers 12 treatment rooms and suites—most with private outdoor terraces

claims.text: A two-acre organic garden and orchard grows fruits, vegetables, flowers and herbs for the resort's kitchens, and guests can suit up and step into its apiary.

findings.quote: As overseer of The Ranch’s two-acre organic garden and orchard, Mark grows the fruits, vegetables, flowers, and herbs that provide the resort’s kitchens
the organic garden is home to a rainbow of veggies, flowers, and honeybees—suiting up and stepping into the apiary was a highlight of my stay.

claims.text: The property is spread out and paths can be hilly, though they are paved.

findings.quote: The property is spread out; paths can be hilly, but they are paved

claims.text: Room views vary from the valley and golf course to vineyards and oak trees, some filtering a view of the Lodge and its parking lot, so choose carefully when booking.

findings.quote: Room views vary from the valley and golf course to vineyards and stretches of oak trees that filter the view of The Lodge and the adjacent parking lot, so if you have your heart set on a specific vista, take care when booking.

claims.text: All spa facilities are designed for adult use, and the minimum age for massages is 18.

findings.quote: All spa facilities are designed for adult use. Minimum age for facials is 16 years old and minimum age for massages is 18 years old.
